{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes doc/files.md and doc/release-notes-36629.md solely to document the new index and RPC.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates accompany the feature implementation rather than serving as the primary subject of the PR."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds src/index/txoscriptindex.cpp, src/index/txoscriptindex.h, src/index/txoscriptindex_key.h, and associated tests under src/test/.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.70,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces txoscriptindex, an optional index under src/index/ providing compact script pubkey history. It delivers a long-sought index capability attempted across five PRs since 2013, with low storage overhead (~54 GB) and pruned-node compatibility."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds getscripthistory in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp (+632 lines) and refactors shared transaction JSON rendering in src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Adds the getscripthistory RPC allowing queries by script hash, address, or ranged descriptor. This directly resolves a long-standing capability gap that forced external wallets and explorers to run separate third-party indexing servers."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies test/functional/test_runner.py and src/test/fuzz/rpc.cpp by one line each to register new tests.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The PR adds tests for the new index and RPC rather than modifying shared test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp and src/node/caches.cpp to allocate cache and initialize the index.",

      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Initialization and cache allocation edits purely support index startup rather than modifying generic utility infrastructure."
    }
  ],
